question: Does any polynomial-time decider for GLOBAL_TRANSPORT on the exact R44CC/R44CD image family lift by pure composition to a polynomial-time decider for arbitrary GRAPH_3_COLORING?

construction.input: arbitrary finite simple graph G=(V,E), n=|V|, m=|E|
construction.map: I(G)=(A_G,B_G) using the frozen R44CC local gadget and edge gadget
construction.construction_time: O(n+m) under ordinary explicit graph/CNF representation

black_box_contract.solver_output: YES iff a globally compatible recovered transport exists

proof_obligations: reuse only already-sealed R44CD completeness/soundness facts, not finite enumeration, for the universal implication
show that if T_S is polynomial then T_C is polynomial
show witness lifting both ways remains polynomially verifiable
separate theorem-level composition proof from finite audit
do not claim that a polynomial S exists
do not claim that all possible invariants have been ruled out
success_condition: A proof-carrying verifier certifies the black-box composition implication and exact complexity accounting while preserving all firewalls.
